description: Seed a form with initial records in bulk. Use it to fill a form with test or reference data. For one record create_record is better. Supports subforms through subforms.

records.description: Array of records. Each record is a hash {field_name: value}

subforms.description: Subform links [{property_id, dtype_id, subform_dtype_id}]. Rarely needed by hand.

name: seed_records
